extraction_notes: S-1/A discloses customer names only as anonymized Customer A/B/C in revenue concentration tables (per gov-customer confidentiality). Named programs (DIA MARRS, USCYBERCOM TACTICALCRUISER, Army GFIM Phase 1) are disclosed at the program level but not tied to PE numbers in this filing. These are services/IDIQ-style awards rather than line-item Procurement (P-40) or RDT&E (R-2) PEs typical of defense-platform primes, so J-Book corpus coverage is expected to be sparse.
